T71–T80 have no recovered authoritative definitions per root; source recovery is required, not fabrication.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Dense layered blue-white conifers enclose a small snow clearing. Warm floor belongs to purchased camp.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Normal gameplay camera compares density, silhouette, contrast, actor scale and occlusion before/after clearing; preserve no painted paths beyond camp.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Fenced warm court, heated center, perimeter stock/counter pads and separated customer approaches.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Keep two distinct usable bidirectional gates per latest owner instruction; prove player/loaded worker/hostile routes; centered furnace and substantial daylight fence. Two-gate mandate is owner scope, not inferred count from a crop.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Rod station at fish-filled shoreline; contextual stand point; visible fish acquisition into stack.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Acquire by proximity, animate source-to-carrier movement with conservation; do not replace with invisible counter increment.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Whole fish enter staffed grill and cooked whole-fish-shaped output stacks on distinct tray.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Prove raw intake, processing, output buffer, pickup and empty/full states; no mandatory fillet intermediate inferred from A.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Outside customers request specific goods; inside counters/pads accept goods; green cash appears separately and is collected/spent. B includes raw logs/meat sales.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Queue/order/restock/service/exit and one payment per transaction. Counter catalogue controls eligibility; no universal finished-goods-only restriction.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Rods transform into orange/yellow intake and inclined physical conveyor feeding the grill.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Paid upgrade changes mesh, connection and function; test single debit, interrupted purchase, cancel and reload. Edit duration is not gameplay duration.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Player and helpers carry stock to pedestrian counters as automated processing continues.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Manual and automated routes coexist; independent helper jobs, accessible pickup/restock faces, congestion recovery and visible transfers.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Player returns from exterior with mixed tall wood/meat stacks and supplies matching counters.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Mixed types remain readable at normal camera and through gates; apply owner two-row carry direction and keep unlimited logical inventory separately from bounded visual instances.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Wheat-like source mechanizes; stalks feed blue processor and round bread-like output accumulates.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Maintain separate visible resource and processing chain. Exact flour intermediate, ratios and throughput remain design choices.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Several product lines, helpers, pedestrian orders, cash and vehicle-side demand coexist.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Capture real simultaneous demand/production/carry/queue operation at gameplay zoom; prove fair reservations, no starvation/deadlock and stable frame pacing under final crowd load.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Two differentiated inlet belts enter burger-marked assembler; short outlet reaches vehicle counter; cash arcs to a separate inside pad.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Prove ingredient-specific ports, supported transfers and one real completed order/payment. No source-grounded recipe quantities or throughput numbers.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Large unarmored white quadrupeds show health bars, attack effects and meat pickup loop.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Track hostile/huntable role separately from companions; inspect contact, damage, drops, pursuit/return and resource accounting in full cycles.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Paid pad feedback accompanies larger/more numerous orbiting axes.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Retain as source observation; explicit owner preference for two-handed axe/pickaxe needs source/owner adaptation record, role-specific proof and no silent rollback of approved implementation.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Defenses attack outward while economy continues; supplemental shows timber resupply plus perimeter transport and separate equipment rack line.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Prove aiming, damage, refill, exhausted/full buffers, outward threat lanes and concurrent service. Do not invent raw-ore ammunition recipe or transport living characters by belt.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Universal upgradable warehouse, filters, dispatch reservation and overflow are Havenline requirements/design decisions, not witnessed mechanics.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Use exact GitHub render hashes plus runtime geometry; test stock conservation, compatible ports, full-buffer backpressure, interruption/reload and both gate routes.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Dedicated fish buffer/manual vehicle loading; perimeter processing-counter link; lower-yard vertical hoist.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Keep alternative transport contexts distinct. Storyboards support topology/appearance only; do not certify hoist cycle timing or automatic universal warehouse.

reference_acceptance_scenarios.observed: Published mini-game includes beasts/Snowmen, frozen survivors, coal/fire upgrades and stage resume; fuel limits and reset rules also exist.
reference_acceptance_scenarios.implementation_acceptance: Use for source context and explicit inclusion/exclusion ledger. Do not import energy wall, stage reset economy, unseen Snowman visual design or exact balances into Havenline.
